description: Unit test class for RequireVoidReasonVoidHandler, testing the validation of void reasons when voiding entities like Patients, Encounters, Obs, etc. within the OpenMRS API.

classes.name: RequireVoidReasonVoidHandlerTest
classes.description: Test suite for the RequireVoidReasonVoidHandler class, verifying proper handling of void reason validation.

methods.name: handle_shouldThrowIllegalArgumentExceptionIfPatientVoidReasonIsNull
methods.description: Tests that an IllegalArgumentException is thrown if null is provided as void reason for a patient.

methods.name: handle_shouldThrowIllegalArgumentExceptionIfEncounterVoidReasonIsEmpty
methods.description: Tests that an IllegalArgumentException is thrown if an empty string is provided as void reason for an encounter.

methods.name: handle_shouldThrowIllegalArgumentExceptionIfObsVoidReasonIsBlank
methods.description: Tests that an IllegalArgumentException is thrown if a blank string is provided as void reason for an observation.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotThrowExceptionIfVoidReasonIsNotBlank
methods.description: Verifies that no exception is thrown when a non-blank void reason is provided for an observation.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotThrowExceptionIfVoidReasonIsNullForUnsupportedTypes
methods.description: Verifies that no exception is thrown if void reason is null for a Person entity, which may not require a reason.
